en.headline: Female staff member burned in Hong Kong Cultural Centre stage fire
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze behind the Grand Theatre stage around 11:38am after a female employee in her 20s suffered burns to her face and arms.
body: A fire broke out behind the stage of the Grand Theatre at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre on Salisbury Road in Tsim Sha Tsui at about 11:23am on Monday, according to multiple reports.

A female staff member in her 20s sustained burns to her face and arms while attempting to deal with the blaze, which was suspected to have been caused by an electrical fault. She remained conscious and was taken by ambulance to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for treatment after paramedics applied cooling dressings.

Firefighters arrived and used one hose reel and a breathing apparatus team to extinguish the fire by about 11:38am. The cause remains under investigation by the authorities. An evening performance by the Hong Kong String Orchestra had been scheduled at the venue, but organisers had not immediately confirmed any impact.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀文化中心主劇場後台火警 女職員面手燒傷送院
zh.dek: 消防員約15分鐘將火救熄，一名二十多歲女職員面部及手臂燒傷，清醒送伊利沙伯醫院治理。
body: 今日（19日）上午約11時23分，尖沙咀梳士巴利道香港文化中心主劇場舞台後方發生火警，現場一度冒煙。
一名二十多歲女職員在處理火警期間面部及手臂被燒傷，救護員為其敷上降溫敷料後，傷者清醒由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。起火原因懷疑與電力故障有關。
消防到場出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，約15分鐘後於上午11時38分將火救熄。警方及消防正調查起火原因。文化中心當晚原定有香港管弦樂團演出，主辦方暫未公布是否受影響。
